screening.screening_rationale: Patient provides appropriate, detailed description of photo elements under timed conditions. Speech contains concrete observations (farm, horse, pregnant woman, girl with book, mountains, water, house, tree, rocky hill) organized in a listing pattern typical of picture description tasks. Self-corrections and uncertainty expressions ('Oh I see', 'But i dunno') are within normal limits. No evidence of thought disorder markers such as derailment, tangentiality, poverty of content, or disorganization. The response directly addresses the task demands.

Patient provides coherent, detailed description of the second photo with adequate information content. Describes multiple relevant elements: interaction between man and woman, emotional expressions, time period (1960s), visual details (window, poster, clothing, hairstyles). Frequent use of discourse markers and filler expressions reflects contemporary casual speech patterns rather than thought disorder. Information transmission remains effective. No evidence of derailment, tangentiality, poverty of content, or other FTD markers. Response appropriately addresses the picture description task.

Patient provides detailed description of third photo characterized as abstract line art. Multiple concrete observations included: lines, eclipse, building, person on bridge, water, boat, people on dock, house, clouds, sunrise. Self-corrections and spatial relationship clarifications reflect normal cognitive processing of complex visual material. Discourse markers and informal grammatical constructions consistent with rapid speech under timed conditions. Information content remains adequate with specific visual elements identified. No evidence of derailment, tangentiality, poverty of content, or other FTD markers. Response appropriately addresses the task demands.
